items.title: Is Microsoft (MSFT) Building A Bigger AI Role In Scientific Labs?
items.summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) and Danaher Corporation announced a broad AI partnership focused on laboratory automation and scientific instrumentation in November 2026. The collaboration will use Microsoft Azure and Danaher’s Foundry platform to build interoperable agentic AI systems for lab workflows. Internal trials reported sizable efficiency gains for less experienced scientists using the new agent-based tools in Danaher’s test environments. The Microsoft and Danaher agentic AI lab alliance...

items.title: Warning for CoreWeave: Satya Nadella Says “Selling to One or Two Customers Is Not a Business”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft CEO Satya Nadella said selling to one or two customers “is not a business,” and that Microsoft builds its own capacity first and rents last. That’s a warning for CoreWeave, whose three biggest customers made up 72% of second-quarter revenue, and for Nebius and IREN, which count Microsoft as an anchor customer.

items.title: Musk Warns AI’s “Cash Shortage Is Also Going to Be Nuts Next Year.” Credit Markets Put SpaceX Beside Oracle
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk warned on X that AI’s compute delays will take “hundreds of billions of incremental dollars just for working capital” next year. SpaceX relies more on outside credit than its CFO’s self-funding message suggests.

items.title: Billionaire Chase Coleman’s Tiger Global Cut Its Alphabet Stake by 42%
items.summary: Tiger Global dumped a huge chunk of its Alphabet shares just as Google Cloud exploded and free cash flow turned deeply negative. A 13F can't explain why, but it does expose a sizing lesson that matters more than the sale.
